# probe

<!-- Generated by nightseam from api/contracts/probe/; do not edit. -->

A family of the `nightseam.duplex/1` profile, declared in `model.json`, `protocol.json`.
The tiers it declares bring the built-in family `duplex`, imported implicitly.

### Payload

A record. A payload: a base with a count and a note that may be absent or null.

Extends `Base`.

| Field | Type | Presence | Constraints | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `text` | `string` | required | — | inherited from `Base`. The text of the payload. |
| `count` | `integer` | required | — |  |
| `note` | `string` | optional, nullable | — |  |

In `go`:

```go
type Payload struct {
	Text  string                                     `json:"text"`
	Count int64                                      `json:"count"`
	Note  runtime.Optional[runtime.Nullable[string]] `json:"note,omitzero"`
}
```

In `typescript`:

```typescript
/** A payload: a base with a count and a note that may be absent or null. */
export interface Payload {
  /** The text of the payload. */
  "text": string;
  "count": number;
  "note"?: string | null;
}
```

For example:

```json
{
  "text": "‹text›",
  "count": 0,
  "note": "‹note›"
}
```

### Status

An enum. Where a probe stands.

One of `ready`, `done`, `context.example`.

In `go`:

```go

```

In `typescript`:

```typescript

```

For example:

```

Used by `Seen.status`.

## Carried types

These are this family's own types, declared in the same language by a built-in family Nightseam declares of itself and imported by the tier that brings it, with no `imports` line. A declaration of this family may not declare one and names it by the built-in that declares it — `duplex.Envelope`.

### Envelope

A record, carried from the built-in `duplex` family. One message of the nightseam.duplex/1 profile: the members the peer acts on, and nothing else.

| Field | Type | Presence | Constraints | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `version` | `integer` | required | — | The profile's version, 1. |
| `kind` | `string` | required | — | request, response, event or cancel. |
| `id` | `string` | optional | — | What correlates a response or a cancel with its request. |
| `method` | `string` | optional | — | The method a request names. |
| `params` | `json` | optional | — | A request's parameters. |
| `result` | `json` | optional | — | A response's result. |
| `error` | `json` | optional | — | A response's error. |
| `event` | `string` | optional | — | The event an event frame names. |
| `data` | `json` | optional | — | An event's data. |
| `traceparent` | `string` | optional | — | The W3C Trace Context of the frame. |
| `tracestate` | `string` | optional | — | The vendor state of that trace. |
| `meta` | map of `string` | optional | — | What a request or an event carries about the call, delivered to the handler beside the payload. |

In `go`:

	Version     int64                               `json:"version"`
	Kind        string                              `json:"kind"`
	ID          runtime.Optional[string]            `json:"id,omitzero"`
	Method      runtime.Optional[string]            `json:"method,omitzero"`
	Params      runtime.Optional[any]               `json:"params,omitzero"`
	Result      runtime.Optional[any]               `json:"result,omitzero"`
	Error       runtime.Optional[any]               `json:"error,omitzero"`
	Event       runtime.Optional[string]            `json:"event,omitzero"`
	Data        runtime.Optional[any]               `json:"data,omitzero"`
	Traceparent runtime.Optional[string]            `json:"traceparent,omitzero"`
	Tracestate  runtime.Optional[string]            `json:"tracestate,omitzero"`
	Meta        runtime.Optional[map[string]string] `json:"meta,omitzero"`
}
```

In `typescript`:
